complexity.notes: The dict is keyed by a fixed 3-character set, so lookups are O(1) worst case, not just average case. `bracket in "({["` is perfectly idiomatic for a tiny fixed alphabet. This is the same approach as the previous version, just with the elif chain collapsed into the lookup.
complexity.summary: Single pass with an explicit stack: push openers, and on a closer pop and compare against a fixed dict mapping closers to their openers. Valid iff every pop matches and the stack ends empty.
